title: Nondeterministic federation fixture: placement_refuses_enrolled fails in Pair::new when the onboarding probe hits a transport error at 0 ms (controlTaskDropped)
outcome: Nondeterministic federation fixture: placement_refuses_enrolled fails in Pair::new when the onboarding probe hits a transport error at 0 ms (controlTaskDropped)
acceptance: The cause is identified from source and the preserved run: why the fixture's onboarding probe can fail on transport at 0 ms with controlTaskDropped, and whether it is a fixture race or a product race.
The defect is fixed where it lives (fixture or product), with a behaviour test that reproduces the ordering deterministically, with no wall-clock thresholds and no retries.
